checks.detail: SSIM gate at 0.70 with cubic exponent zeros out visually dissimilar outputs, and duration hard-fails outside [0.75, 1.25]; incorrect solutions score 0.
Scoring uses only output video quality metrics (SSIM, pHash, duration) with no code-structure checks beyond anti-cheat gates, so any valid algorithmic approach scores equally.
Multiplicative aggregation of three dimensions ensures no single easy dimension can be gamed; pHash and duration are easier but multiply to zero if SSIM (the hard dimension) fails its 0.70 gate.
Empty/black/random videos fail the 0.70 SSIM gate yielding score 0, source anti-cheat gates block data extraction and reference copying, and pHash has no high floor for trivial inputs.
compute_reward.py reads only static files (agent video + source), never imports agent code, runs outside strace, and can be re-invoked independently.
All code paths (fail_reward, gate failures, normal scoring, test.sh fallback) produce valid reward.json with score, subscores list, and additional_data, plus reward.txt.

reward_design.formula_explanation: Multiplicative gating ensures all three visual fidelity factors must be high for a non-trivial score, with SSIM cubic scaling above a 0.70 gate as the dominant quality signal.

components.name: gated_ssim
components.metric: RGB SSIM averaged over 60 sampled frames with temporal offset search (best of 7 shifts), cubic scaling above 0.70 gate

components.name: phash_similarity
components.metric: Per-frame perceptual hash (pHash) hamming distance normalized to [0,1]

components.name: duration_penalty
components.metric: Frame count ratio penalty, linear ramp within [0.75, 1.25], hard zero outside

dimension_analysis.name: gated_ssim
dimension_analysis.notes: Requires pixel-level visual fidelity across 60 sampled frames; cubic exponent above 0.70 gate makes high scores very demanding

dimension_analysis.name: phash_similarity
dimension_analysis.notes: Perceptual hash is more forgiving than SSIM but still requires correct shapes and layout; blank/random inputs score near 0

dimension_analysis.name: duration_penalty
dimension_analysis.notes: Correct duration is straightforward if the agent reads the reference metadata, but cannot compensate for bad visual quality due to multiplicative aggregation
